lua_assertions:
for _ = 1, 64 do
    local ok, message = pcall(_ITG_OPTIONS_LEVEL, nil)
    assert(not ok and message:find('Expected ModsLevel; got nil', 1, true))
    assert(not pcall(_ITG_OPTIONS_LEVEL, 'not a level'))
    assert(_ITG_OPTIONS_LEVEL('ModsLevel_Current') == 'ModsLevel_Current')
    assert(_ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_Current', 'XMod') == 1)
end
